comment.text: A step label in a progress sequence on the AI paywall completion page, representing the stage where AI features are being enabled.

usage.context:
const isBackup = isBackupService(service);
 
 const getActivateStepLabel = () =>
 isAIService(service)
 ? t("AIPaywallCallbackStepActivate")
 : isDocsConnect
 ? t("DocsConnectCallbackStepActivate")
 : isBackup
 ? t("BackupPaywallCallbackStepActivate")
 : "";
